title: Strongly interacting fermions under imaginary rotation
summary: In the present study, we investigate the phase diagram of strongly-interacting fermions under imaginary rotation. We employ the linear sigma model coupled to quarks in the mean field approximation. The fermion expectation values are computed in the local density approximation (LDA), using the well-known expressions derived using cylindrical modes for states under rigid rotation, at finite temperature $T$ and chemical potential $μ$.
